question: As per the Sustainable Development Goals — National Indicator Framework Progress Report, 2025, published in June 2025, what was the percentage of the total waste processed during the year 2024–2025, indicating progress in waste management efficiency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**80.7%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Sustainable Development Goals — National Indicator Framework (NIF) Progress Report, 2025**, released in **June 2025**, India has made significant strides in waste management.
 
• The report indicates that for the fiscal year **2024–2025**, the percentage of total municipal solid waste processed stands at **80.7%**.
 
• This data is a crucial metric under **SDG Goal 11** (Sustainable Cities and Communities), specifically monitoring **Indicator 11.6.1**, which tracks the proportion of municipal solid waste regularly collected and with adequate final discharge out of total municipal solid waste generated.
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** is the nodal agency responsible for publishing this progress report, which tracks **India’s** performance against the global **2030 Agenda**.
